titre: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
chapo: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Read more
extrait: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back, too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

titre: God of War TV Series Officially Casts the Perfect Faye
chapo: Amazon Prime Video's God of War series has cast Deborah Ann Woll. She'll reprise her role of Faye from the PlayStation games.
extrait: Deborah Ann Woll is making the jump from the games to the show Production of Prime Video's God of War series is well underway as filming has resumed with Dave Bautista in the role of Kratos. On Monday, Amazon announced another key role has been cast: Deborah Ann Woll will play Faye, a powerful giant warrior and Kratos' wife. Her death kicks off the Norse Saga games. Woll's name will certainly sound familiar to players of God of War Ragnarök as she's reprising her role from the game. Faye appeared in flashbacks during Ragnarök, which allowed for Kratos to show off a more tender side of himself. She also had a guiding hand in the first game. (She left behind all that yellow paint.) "Along their journey, Kratos and Atreus discover secrets about Faye that make them wonder how well they truly knew her at all," reads a news release for the Amazon show. Woll will also star in next year's God of War Laufey, which is due out in May. It will find Faye in the afterlife for gods across various pantheons. When Faye realizes that the plans she laid forth for Kratos and Atreus are in jeopardy, she works to ensure they come to fruition. Fans already have plenty of theories about what events Laufey might cover from Faye's point-of-view. It's not known yet if the Prime Video TV series will adapt any material from Laufey or if Woll will only appear as Faye in flashback scenes. It's also possible all-new scenes will be written for the show that feature Faye. Woll is best known for her work in True Blood, Daredevil, and Daredevil: Born Again. She's also guest starred on the actual play series Critical Role and recently appeared in an episode of Polygon's Shelf Quest series. Prime Video's God of War series does not have a release date at this time.

chapo: Faye is joining the pantheon on Amazon

Faye will be in God of War's Amazon show – played by game actor Deborah Ann Woll As announced by Amazon, Woll is once more playing Faye, after making her first appearance as the character – the mother of Atreus and longtime partner of Kratos – in flashbacks and vision sequences during 2022's God of War Ragnarok. Woll joins Dave Bautista's Kratos and Callum Vinson's Atreus in a first season that will likely mirror much of 2018's God of War narrative – namely, how Kratos and Atreus journey on a quest to spread Faye's ashes. Bautista replaced original Kratos actor Ryan Hurst after he suffered an injury during production, forcing cameras to stop rolling. Woll will also portray Faye once more in next year's standalone game God of War Laufey, which sees her fight through the mysterious Everywhen to enact her plans to save Kratos and her son, Atreus. She's even accompanied by a mysterious talking cube, voiced by The Boys actor Jack Quaid. Naturally. "I've known about this for nearly ten years, and I haven't been able to talk about it." Woll, who also said she wasn't put off by the negative response to the title, explained earlier this year at Game Con Canada (via CG Mag). She added, "When [director] Cory [Barlog] brought me in to talk about doing Ragnarok and show me the 2018 game, he already had a poster for the Laufey game with me and a cube. A cube that's been there since the beginning. It's deeply a part of the lore." For more, we have a complete guide to the God of War TV show, plus a look ahead to all the new TV shows on the horizon.
